summary: This informational document explains why many Internet applications need object-based security mechanisms. The Cryptographic Message Syntax (CMS) has long offered a binary format based on ASN.1. It sets out use cases and requirements for a JSON-based approach, JOSE.

eli5.summary: Many programs need to lock and sign packages of data. This lists why and what is needed for a version that uses JSON.
